text: Month three. You don't take the lift anymore. You take phone calls walking. And your bad days... feel less bad. A huge Lancet review in twenty twenty-five pulled together fifty-seven studies. People walking seven thousand steps a day, compared with two thousand, had about a fifth lower risk of depression symptoms. {playful} Quick question. What's your step count today? Check your phone and tell me in the comments. Be honest.
